author: Stahly
description:
There was no sign of the summer slump on Tale of Painters in August. As far as new releases go, we were in a busy period, with new starter sets for Necromunda, Grimdark Future, and Trench Crusade that we took a closer look at, as well as new paints from The Army Painter and Gaahleri. On top of that, we painted a few cool models. Here is a roundup of everything you might have missed this month.

The post The best of Tale of Painters: August 2026 appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The best of Tale of Painters: August 2026
